initial.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a continuous landscape panorama for a toddler educational Hong Kong exploration game. Primary request: redraw Hong Kong as one coherent, highly detailed, ultra-wide 6:1 panorama, maximum native resolution. Horizontal eye-level cinematic view, warm late afternoon, playful high quality dimensional painted storybook style, crisp architectural detail and clear perspective. This must unmistakably be HONG KONG, not a European town. Composition: the LEFT half is Victoria Harbour viewed from the Hong Kong Island waterfront. Foreground and middle ground left are turquoise harbour water and a curving waterfront promenade; leave a clear empty water lane around 25% width at 72% height for a separately animated green-white Star Ferry. On the opposite Kowloon shore, paint Tsim Sha Tsui's slender red-brick Clock Tower with pale stone trims, round white clock face, octagonal cupola and a spire naturally among waterfront trees and low buildings, around 14% image width. Behind it show clustered modern towers and distant green hills, genuine Hong Kong harbour feeling. Shoreline and waterfront promenade gently continue toward the right, then naturally reveal Hong Kong Island's streets. The RIGHT half is Central and Sheung Wan: tightly clustered Hong Kong high rises behind recognisable older narrow Chinese shopfronts, balconies, air conditioners, hanging small Chinese shop signs and urban trees. The Bank of China Tower, a tall silver blue asymmetrical triangular-faceted high rise with white diagonal X bracing and two slender roof masts, is part of the MID-DISTANCE skyline around 66% width, its base obscured by surrounding real city buildings, never standing on the road. The foreground on the RIGHT is a continuous realistic Hong Kong asphalt tram street with two parallel embedded tram rails across the image at 85% height, light overhead tram wires and poles, a separate lane for a double-decker bus at 95% height. Leave clear empty tram and bus travel lanes; no tram and no bus painted into background because animated vehicles added later. At 88% width, paint a welcoming small authentic Hong Kong dim sum shop recessed into a streetfront building, bamboo steamer baskets and dumplings on its actual counter, soft wood awning, warmly lit interior, naturally architectural not an isolated sticker. Make all these areas one CONTINUOUS panoramic painting with same light and colour, harbour shoreline and city streets coherently connected through one promenade that gradually becomes a lively sidewalk. Broad spacious composition, no panels or vertical splits, no foreground pasted isolated skyscrapers, no duplicated landmarks, no western pitched-roof streets, no beach, no frame, no title, no watermark, no fake large readable advertising. This is an illustrative tour of landmarks, not a literal map, but Clock Tower belongs across the harbour and trams belong on Hong Kong Island. Keep distant skyline behind water and urban road in the foreground right. Weather clear with subtle clouds.

refinement.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached Hong Kong panorama. Keep the warm coherent light, Hong Kong harbour, Clock Tower across water, mid-distance Bank of China triangular tower integrated among skyline buildings, old Hong Kong shopfronts and the dim sum shop at the far right. Make it a stylised dimensional children's picture-book painting with cleaner broad colour shapes, crisp edges and charming 3D forms, less photographic realism. The important change is CAMERA / roadway: this is a SIDE-SCROLLING children's game. Redraw the foreground road in the RIGHT HALF as a level horizontal street seen broadside: from image x=55% to x=100%, two tram rails must run LEFT TO RIGHT straight and perfectly horizontal at image y=83.5% and y=89%, so a side-view tram sprite can drive horizontally along them. The separate bus lane is below the rails around 95% height. Do not draw rails diagonally into the distance. Buildings and shopfronts remain behind this horizontal street with a sidewalk edge parallel to the rails, the dim sum shop counter visible and recessed into its actual building at the far right. The waterfront promenade on the left gradually transitions behind the road into the city sidewalk, there must be no visual panel seam. Keep the left half clear blue harbour water; the left 30% of the image is open water from y=58% to 95% for an animated ferry, so DO NOT cover it with a foreground railing or bushes. Shift any foreground railing to the middle transition x=38%-55%. Do not render any vehicles or people in this background. Keep architecture in the mid-distance, tower bases behind urban blocks. Clock Tower on the opposite shoreline, not on this street. Full panoramic 3:1 framing and highest native detail, no borders, no title, no watermark.
